title: All conventional dynamic marks
description: One of each conventional dynamic marking the renderer maps to SMuFL glyphs, one per quarter note: pppppp through ffffff, mp/mf/pf, fp, fz, the sforzando family (sf, sfp, sfpp, sfz, sfzp, sffz), rinforzandos (rf, rfz), niente and z — 27 marks over 7 bars. MNX v19 constrains dynamic-group.value to a closed enum (ppp…fff, n); marks outside it carry an explicit glyphs list, which this scenario exercises. Unmapped values fall back to italic text.
